hasExpiration.description: Indicates whether offer expiration details will appear in the delivered message. If set to true, copy code button must be included in the buttons array, and must appear first in the array.

text.description: Offer details text. Up to 16 characters.

callPermissionRequest.description: Call permission request. Presence of this object enables a call permission request feature, no fields are required. When header is media type call permission request will not be displayed on end-user's device.

shorteningOptions.description: URL shortening options. Applicable only if at least one dynamic URL button is present. Modifying this provided URL outside of our company's services may lead to unexpected results.

customDomain.description: Custom domain to be used for URL shortening.

validityPeriod.description: Template validity period in which WhatsApp will try to deliver a template message. Supported ranges are dependent on template category: 10 seconds to 15 minutes for Authentication, 30 seconds to 12 hours for Utility, and 12 to 48 hours for Marketing. Marketing validity periods apply only to messages sent through the Marketing Messages API and are ignored by the Cloud API.

gotchas: Send the API key as 'Authorization: App <API_KEY>' — the prefix App; Bearer is only for OAuth 2.0 access tokens. Infobip API keys have a predefined expiry date and can be revoked at any time; a missing or invalid credential answers 401.
The OpenAPI lists these API key scopes for this endpoint (x-scopes): whatsapp:manage. Give the key a matching scope when you create it.

Each Infobip account has its own base URL, xxxxx.api.infobip.com, shown once you log in to the Infobip API Resource hub. Set it in INFOBIP_BASE_URL (https://xxxxx.api.infobip.com in this spec is a placeholder). It identifies your account, the API key authenticates it.
Only templates pre-approved by WhatsApp can be sent: filter with status=APPROVED and reuse the exact name and language in send_whatsapp_template.
Paginated: page starts at 0, size defaults to 10 and caps at 100; read paging.totalPages.

List query parameters are declared style form, explode true in the OpenAPI (repeated keys: status=A&status=B, as this example sends them) while their descriptions say comma-separated values. With a single value both readings match.

A 400 on this endpoint is { errorCode, description, action, violations[] (property + violation), resources[] }. Other statuses have no schema in the OpenAPI; the 401 body shown on the authentication page is { requestError: { serviceException: { messageId: 'UNAUTHORIZED', text } } } — handle both shapes.
A 429 means the endpoint's rate limit was hit; limits differ per endpoint. Retry with exponential backoff and honour the Retry-After header when present.
